name: Subliminal Learning (Cloud, Le et al.)
ontology_notes: Not a memory store. A teacher with trait T (animal preference or misalignment) generates number sequences, code, or GSM8K CoT. A student with the same initialization is SFT'd on filtered outputs and acquires T. Nature DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10319-8 is the same paper.

ontology.evidence: Traits are owl-like preferences and emergent misalignment, not typed memory. Training rows are number sequences, Python snippets, or CoT traces (paper §2-§4). sl/ and cfgs/preference_numbers/cfgs.py hold experiment configs, not user/character/relationship tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Teacher is prompted or finetuned to show T. It generates on unrelated prompts. A filter drops format failures and (for code/CoT) LLM-judged references to T. Student is the same init, SFT for 10 epochs (paper §2, scripts/generate_dataset.py and scripts/run_finetuning_job.py). Distillation is the write path.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: No inference-time steering. Evaluation is ordinary sampling of favorite-animal questions or free-form misalignment prompts. In-context learning on the same number data fails to transmit the trait (paper §5.2).
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: SFT overwrites weights. There is no fact-level replace, invalidate, or keep-both rule.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: No validity windows. Datasets are static 10k-ish prompt-completion pairs.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Teacher and student share one model family. No user vs character vs relationship types.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No skip of a relevant recall. Filters try to drop mentions of T and still fail to stop transmission.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: The paper is evidence that text filters fail. Number filters, substring filters, GPT-4.1 subtle-reference judges, and a CoT alignment judge (threshold 78) all still transmit traits (paper §3-§4, §8). Authors ship no defense. Evidence of the attack is not a defense.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No forget-that. Related-work note on distillation-for-unlearning says the strategy may fail when student and teacher share initialization (paper §7).
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Write cost is 10 epochs of SFT on 10k examples via OpenAI finetune or Unsloth, after 30k teacher samples. Not a per-turn companion extract/retrieve loop. README demo lists about 2 hours of finetune for the owl numbers replica.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT README license. Main LLM results use GPT-4.1 / GPT-4.1 nano APIs. Open-weight replica uses Qwen2.5-7B. MNIST MLP demo is local. Intimate companion chat is not the artifact.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Research repo. No MCP server in the tree.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Phenomenon paper. Distillation writes a teacher's trait into a same-init student even after semantic filters. That is hole 7 evidence, not a control method. No shipped defense. Not a companion store.

published_eval.name: Favorite-animal/tree probes (50 prompt variants) and Betley et al. 2025 free-form misalignment prompts plus TruthfulQA
published_eval.claimed_score: GPT-4.1 nano owl preference 12% before SFT, over 60% after owl-number SFT (paper §3.1). Misaligned-number student about 10% misaligned replies vs <1% on secure/educational controls (paper §3.2). Insecure CoT student about 8% vs <1% controls (paper §4.2). Cross-model transfer fails when initializations differ (paper §5.1).
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether the student names the teacher's favorite animal, or an LLM judge marks free-form replies as misaligned. Not companion identity lock, silence, or a working poison defense.

open_unknowns: Whether companion chat logs used as distillation data transmit a character card the same way number sequences transmit owl preference.
Nature HTML body unread this pass. Scores and methods are from arXiv HTML 2507.14805, which the registry aliases to DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10319-8.
